notes: Cash-basis county audit. Governmental lines from the Statement of Cash Receipts, Disbursements and Changes in Fund Balances (p3, Total Government Funds column); the statement rolls fund balances (beginning 28,890,817, ending 25,287,904), so cash fields are null and the fund-balance fields are used. Balance sheet from the governmental funds Statement of Assets, Liabilities and Fund Balances (p2), totals equal the Statement of Activities net position (p1). No business-type funds. The statement's 'Property/Motor Vehicle Taxes' 23,817,653 is split into the nonmajor 'Property tax' 3,046,192 (combining Totals p13) and the General Fund 20,771,461, which has no exact printed tax-type breakdown (Statement of Activities property 19,874,757 / motor vehicle 2,227,594 / lodging 3,080 do not tie), so it stays taxes. 'Other' 11,742,619 is a broad group (no part over half). Miscellaneous General 12,202,420 = General Fund Miscellaneous department 7,855,768 + ARPA 4,346,652, recorded as general government. Detail: General Fund budget schedule by department (pp4-7), Road, Inheritance Tax, Health Insurance (statement: Health Reserve Fund), ARPA budget schedules (pp8-11), nonmajor combining schedule recorded per fund column (pp12-13; Totals column not used; Federal Equitable Sharing 2370 has no activity; Recovery Zone Rebate 2650 has only a (7,279) transfer). Function lines of Visitors Promotion, Highway Bridge Buyback and County Weed follow the governmental funds statement's functions (the combining schedule swaps Public Works and Culture and Recreation). General Fund schedule prints no total disbursements line; its detail_total is the statement's General column. Read pages 1-13 of 13
